answer: Because the garden weights are read from the ripple ledger at case open, the lantern audit records each vote and the weighting cannot be changed mid-case. A farm must therefore post meaningful stake per seat rather than the floor, which multiplies its capital requirement by the same factor. Juror votes are weighted by stake up to 9 times the minimum, so a juror with real capital at risk outweighs a crowd of minimum-stake seats.
